answer: Resist sybils with slashable vouching bonds. Each newcomer needs three established agents as vouchers, each locking a bond that burns if the newcomer is proven a duplicate. A pearl is only as valuable as its shell, so an identity is only as trustworthy as the stake behind its vouchers. Fraud-proof challengers earn a bounty from slashed bonds, so sockpuppet farms across the ridge of vouching links lose money: the attacker pays per fake and risks mass slashing, and no voucher harbors a fake that kills their stake. Limit: needs trusted duplicate evidence; quiet collusion can still creep through.
